gloss: to trample; to tread down; to devastate

definitions.gloss: to trample; to tread down; to walk all over and damage
definitions.explanation: To step on and damage something, especially plants, fields, or ground, by walking or stepping on them roughly. Can also be used figuratively for devastating or laying waste to an area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花壇|かだん}→花壇：11075_kadan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{荒|あ}らされた。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{荒|あ}らしてしまった。

⟦{鹿|しか}→鹿：04347_shika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}り{込|こ}んで→入り込む：04629_hairikomu⟧、⟦{作物|さくもつ}→作物：02823_sakumotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{荒|あ}らしていった。
examples.english: A herd of deer broke into the field and trampled the crops.

notes:
Compound verb of ⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧ (to step on) and ⟦{荒|あ}らす→荒らす：14057_arasu⟧ (to lay waste, to damage). A godan verb conjugating with the ⟦{荒|あ}らす→荒らす：14057_arasu⟧ ending.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark the thing being trampled.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{花壇|かだん}→花壇：11075_kadan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{荒|あ}らす: to trample a flower bed
- ⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{荒|あ}らす: to trample a field
- ⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{荒|あ}らす: to trample a lawn
- ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{荒|あ}らす: to trample a garden

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{踏|ふ}みつける→踏みつける：06089_fumitsukeru⟧: to stamp on, to trample — focuses on stepping on with force
- ⟦{荒|あ}らす→荒らす：14057_arasu⟧: to lay waste, to devastate — broader term for destruction
- ⟦{踏|ふ}みにじる→踏みにじる：15447_fuminijiru⟧: to trample, to violate — often used figuratively for trampling on rights or dignity
